field_principles.flagged_for_v381: Closes the discover->ingest->plan loop: names the strongest method for the next planner.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. Records ingestion completed with verifiable citations.
field_principles.methods_mapped: Each method MUST carry a real arXiv ID/URL; an ingestion note without verifiable citations is treated as fabrication.

methods_mapped.failure_mode: A partial checkpoint can validate the mechanism while still failing to match the published accuracy target.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Reproduce the native nano-trm Sudoku Extreme baseline before claiming any Carnot verifier lift.
methods_mapped.name: TRM Sudoku baseline reproduction

methods_mapped.failure_mode: Compute leakage or public-task memorization can look like verifier value unless full-finetune and no-verifier arms are isolated.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Use bounded full fine-tuning as the adaptation control so verifier admission is separated from generic task adaptation.
methods_mapped.name: TTA-TRM full fine-tuning control

methods_mapped.failure_mode: If candidate pools are near-duplicates or already vote-saturated, the selector learns surface artifacts without pass@1 lift.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Train a selector from verifier-valid and verifier-invalid Sudoku candidate traces sampled from the same TRM checkpoint.
methods_mapped.name: V-STaR accepted/rejected trace selector

methods_mapped.failure_mode: Filtering cannot teach solutions the TRM never samples, and sparse positives can collapse the improve step.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Generate Sudoku traces, filter with the executable Carnot verifier, fine-tune on unique positives, and repeat from cached batches.
methods_mapped.name: STaR / ReST generate-filter-improve loop

methods_mapped.failure_mode: Local row, column, and box satisfaction can still prefer near-valid dead ends unless final exact validity remains authoritative.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Move the Sudoku verifier into candidate expansion so compute is spent on promising partial completions before post-hoc reranking or RFT.
methods_mapped.name: Verifier-guided adaptive Sudoku search
